races.title: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: DEARKEITHANDKATY resumed progress sent chasing after 5 months off when successful at Carlisle (2½m) 5 weeks ago and with the return to further firmly in his favour, he looks to have plenty going for him on the back of a 5 lb rise. This is competitive, though, with Worcester eyecatcher In The Age worthy of note for the Skeltons. Slaney Opera and Jeteye are a pair arriving in red-hot form and also command plenty of respect. DEARKEITHANDKATY (FR) IN THE AGE (FR) SLANEY OPERA (IRE)

races.title: Watch Racing TV In HD Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This looks a really hot race but ALBIE LITTLEWOOD is fancied to complete the 4-timer having still been able to make a winning start over fences despite market weakness at Worcester last month. Smart Decision jumped well for a long way when a close second over C&D on his chasing bow, whilst Ninna Collina was 3-3 over hurdles last season and has the physique to make an even better chaser. ALBIE LITTLEWOOD (IRE) SMART DECISION NINNA COLLINA

races.title: Watch Race Replays At racingtv.com Mares' NH Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur)
races.verdict: NORTHERN SINGER overcame a pace bias in good style at Chepstow on her Rules debut last month and looks capable of defying a penalty. Kirsty's Legacy is an interesting newcomer for a yard which also has plenty of success in this sphere, and would need taking very seriously if the subject of strong support. Go Jackie represents the same connections who sent out a tidy first-time-out bumper winner at Warwick last week and merits consideration, too. NORTHERN SINGER (IRE) KIRSTY'S LEGACY GO JACKIE
